header.name: Alex's Mobs Bedrock RP
header.description:
The definitive Bedrock port of Alex's Mobs! 90+ unique creatures with custom models, textures, animations, 148 custom blocks with full textures, custom item icons, and multi-language support.

Original Java Mod by: Alexthe668, Carro1001, Paint_Ninja
Bedrock Adaptation by: Renderphoenix & devsuki
